name: Advanced Analytics Dashboard
description: ML-based anomaly detection and pattern analysis

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM AnomalyDetectionEvent TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT average(mlPredictionAccuracy) FROM MlPredictionAccuracy TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM PatternDetectionEvent TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM AnomalyDetectionEvent FACET anomalyType SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM AnomalyDetectionEvent FACET severity SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM AnomalyDetectionEvent FACET detectionMethod SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT histogram(confidence, 10, 100) FROM AnomalyDetectionEvent FACET anomalyType SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT modelName, predictionType, average(mlPredictionAccuracy), count(*) FROM MlPredictionAccuracy SINCE 24 hours ago ORDER BY average(mlPredictionAccuracy) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT anomalyType, severity, metricName, confidence, description, timestamp FROM AnomalyDetectionEvent ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT average(confidence) FROM PatternDetectionEvent FACET patternType SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT confidence, (actualValue - baselineValue) / baselineValue * 100 as deviationPercent FROM AnomalyDetectionEvent FACET anomalyType SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM AnomalyDetectionEvent FACET anomalyType TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 24 hours ago
